title: Guidelines for Standards Relating to Full-time National Servicemen's Accommodation in Camps
what_it_is: Guidelines for Standards Relating to Full-time National Servicemen's Accommodation in Camps

sections.label: Accommodation facilities and space standards
sections.summary: Facilities are adequate and benchmarked to BCA and NEA guidelines, with two to 10 personnel per room and about seven square metres per serviceman.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: The facilities are adequate, and comfortable and benchmarked to the guidelines of the Building and Construction Authority (BCA) and the National Environment Agency (NEA) in areas including safety, ventilation design and sanitary provisions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: The number of personnel per room ranges from two to 10, depending on the size of the rooms.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: On top of the shared living facilities, the individual sleeping and resting space for each serviceman is about seven square metres.

sections.label: Toilet and shower cubicle guidelines
sections.summary: Toilet and shower facilities have individual cubicles and urinals, with guidelines of five men per toilet cubicle and eight men per urinal.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Toilet and shower facilities are equipped with individual shower and toilet cubicles as well as urinals, with the guideline of five men to one toilet cubicle and eight men to one urinal.

sections.label: Army COVID-19 ventilation procurement
sections.summary: During the COVID-19 pandemic, the Army procured additional fans and air purifiers distributed across the Army to increase ventilation in office and accommodation spaces.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
sentences.text: During the COVID-19 pandemic, there was a proactive approach by the Army to procure additional fans and air purifiers, distributed across the Army to increase ventilation in office and accommodation spaces.

sections.label: NEA ventilation study and air standards
sections.summary: An August 2021 NEA study found naturally ventilated accommodation spaces had CO2 readings below 800 PPM, and MINDEF/SAF departments joined the NEA/BCA workstream for SS553 and SS554 standards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
sentences.text: In August 2021, NEA concluded a study of MINDEF/SAF accommodation spaces which assessed the adequacy of ventilation in rooms using CO2 samples as proxy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
sentences.text: This study found that these naturally ventilated accommodations spaces had good readings of less than 800 PPM CO2.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
sentences.text: In addition, relevant MINDEF/SAF departments have been incorporated as part of the NEA/BCA biosecure built environment workstream which deals extensively at the whole-of-Government level to meet SS553 and SS554 air quality standards.
